transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess my head just feels kind of foggy lately. I've been making some little mistakes at work... in my client notes. And I keep forgetting what I was just about to do. It's, um, it's not really like me. So... that's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

I guess... yeah. Um. Lately when I wake up, there's just this... heavy, kind of empty feeling in my chest. I mean, I still get through my shifts fine. I talk to people and do what I need to do. But... inside, I just feel kind of flat. Just sad, I suppose.
Have you been feeling anxious or nervous lately?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. I wouldn't say I've been nervous... just what I said before.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. My clothes still fit the same, so... I haven't really noticed any difference.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?

Um... I guess so. Just... family stuff. My tío passed away, and... I don't know, I just keep replaying what I should have done before he died. Like... I should have called him more. Or visited sooner. It's just... I kind of feel like I failed him. As family, I guess. But... yeah. That's it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... about a month, I think. Just... this whole low feeling. It's been hanging over me since then.
Have you been enjoying activities or hobbies that you normally like to do?
Um... I don't know. I guess I haven't really been doing much. Just... going to work and coming home. I don't really feel like doing anything else right now.
Are things that you used to enjoy still giving you pleasure?
Um... not really. I mean, I haven't really been trying to do them, so... I don't know. Nothing really sounds all that good right now.
Are you still able to find pleasure in the things you do?
I mean... like I said, I don't really know. I haven't been doing much to find out. Just getting through work, mostly. I haven't really noticed.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?
No. Um... not that I can think of.
Did something specific happen about a month ago that might have triggered these feelings?
No, not really. I mean, nothing specific happened. It's just... this low, foggy feeling, you know? Feeling guilty for no reason. It's just been hanging over me for about a month now.
Do you think the feelings you've been having are mostly about your tío who passed away?

I guess so. Um... I just keep replaying things. Like what I should have done for him before he died. Should have called more... or visited sooner. I don't know, I just... I end up feeling like I failed him. As family.
Do you think your feelings about your tío's death are worse than what others you know have experienced when they lost someone close?
I don't know. Um... I don't really talk to other people about how they handle things like that. So... I couldn't really say if it's worse. It's just... what I'm dealing with.
Do you think you would be feeling this way even if you hadn't been replaying thoughts about what you could have done for your tío before he died?
I'm... I'm not really sure. I mean... maybe? It's hard to separate it all out. I just know I feel this way right now.
Do you think you would still be feeling this low if you had been able to do everything you felt you should have done for your tío before he died?
I... I really couldn't say. Um... it didn't happen that way, so... I don't know how I'd feel. I just don't know.
Do you think your feelings about your tío's death would get better if time passed, or do you feel like you're stuck in this sadness?
I don't really know. Um... I haven't thought that far ahead. I'm just... dealing with how it is right now.
Do you think your feelings about your tío's death are the main reason you've been feeling sad and empty inside?

I don't... I mean, maybe it's part of it. But lately, even when I'm not thinking about him... I just wake up with this heavy, empty feeling right here in my chest. I still go to work, you know, get through my shift and talk to people, but... inside, I just feel sad. Just kind of flat.
Do you think you would still be feeling this sad and empty if you weren't thinking about your tío who passed away?
I guess... yeah, probably. Like I said, it's just... it's there even when he's not on my mind. So, I guess I would be.
Have you been feeling this way for most of the day, nearly every day, for the past two weeks?
Yeah... I suppose. It's been pretty constant since... well, since my uncle passed. That was about two weeks ago. So, yeah, I guess it's been every day since then.
Have you been feeling this way for at least two weeks?
Yeah... um, like I said. This whole... shift, it really started right after he died. So... yeah, about two weeks ago.
